usage: Grid of image tiles with a short caption. One row per card: image cell, caption cell. Lays out 4-up, or 2-up when the block has exactly 2 cards.
reuseGuidance: Use for image galleries/examples where each image has a short caption. For tiles with CTAs and descriptions use cards-tour.
